remarks: Looking for a stylish, efficient, and budget-friendly place to call home? This updated studio apartment offers a clean, modern layout designed for comfortable single living.  Apartment Features: Modern Kitchen: Brand-new white cabinetry, beautiful granite countertops, and full-size stainless steel refrigerator and stove.  Layout: Open living/sleeping area combo with efficient layout and abundant natural light.  Flooring: Durable, sleek Luxury Vinyl Tile (LVT) flooring throughout-easy to clean and maintain.  Bathroom: Full-size bathroom with bath/shower combination.  Vibe: Small, cozy, and ultra-functional.  Lease Terms & Details: Utilities: Tenant pays electric.  Parking: On-site parking space available for 1 vehicle ($50/month).  Pet Policy: Pet-friendly! Dogs welcome with an additional $50/month fee.  Location: Super convenient Norwalk location close to shopping, dining, public transit, and route 7/I-95 commuters.
